'''Åsane Fotball''' is a Norwegian [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Åsane]]. The club currently competing in [[1. divisjon]], the second tier of the [[Norwegian football league system]], in which they have been participating since their promotion in [[2019 2. divisjon]]. They were relegated from 1. divisjon in [[2018 1. divisjon|2018]]."}}
